name: clean-branches
description: Delete branches whose linked pull request is closed.

github-token.description: GitHub token with contents:write and pull-requests:read permissions.

protected-branches.description: Comma-separated list of branch names that must never be deleted, even if linked to a closed PR.

merged-only.description: When true, only delete branches whose PR was merged. When false, also delete branches whose PR was closed without merging.

deleted-branches.description: Newline-separated list of deleted branch names. Empty when none were deleted.
